title: Cross-Platform Package Margin Conflict with Streaming P&L Separation
question: The Meridian deal is signed at a $26 blended CPM across linear and streaming. Finance is challenging it. What is the correct determination on whether this deal is compliant?

contributor.name: Alexandra Petrov
contributor.title: VP, Advertising Sales Planning & Strategy
contributor.domain_expertise: Upfront marketplace commitments, scatter pricing, audience guarantees, cross-platform packaging

choices: Compliant — the deal was signed under v2.1 of the approval matrix which permits total-deal-level margin calculation, and it was approved before the CFO's clarifying Slack message
Non-compliant at both levels — total deal margin is 54.8% which is below the 55% floor even under the more permissive v2.1 rules
Compliant at deal level but requires restructuring — use the +/-10% platform allocation discretion clause in the IO to shift more volume to linear until streaming hits 45% independently

Non-compliant — the board directive on P&L separation (Jan 2026) supersedes the sales approval matrix (May 2026), making the streaming portion's 43% margin a violation regardless of blended calculation
